budget.budget_amendment: User raised the ceiling to $1000 before new training runs. Interpreted conservatively as total workspace spend, not $1000 additional. Experimental gates unchanged.

data.temperature_fit_objective: micro mean NLL of clean questions using raw logits
data.development_role: the old transfer-v4 development items, selection only
data.previous_test_sets: historical regression evidence only; repeatedly exposed during previous model selection

metric_policy.confidence: max returned option probability after the independently fitted temperature
metric_policy.ties: whole equal-confidence groups; no within-tie selection
metric_policy.primary: micro empirical threshold coverage at error <= 0.05
metric_policy.companion: AURC, right-step integral at whole-tie thresholds, lower is better
secondary: high-confidence errors divided by all answers
metric_policy.bootstrap: 2000 paired source-stratified original-record-group resamples; full statistic recomputed for each draw
metric_policy.uncertainty_scope: dataset sampling only; seed variation reported separately
metric_policy.deployment_policy: threshold selected on fresh threshold-calibration set, applied without re-selection to final test; not a certified error guarantee

screen.soft_target_policy: Keep existing soft-target questions on ordinary soft-target cross-entropy, identically in every arm.
screen.unchanged_checkpoint_control: Re-evaluate the pinned released checkpoint with raw logits and the same calibration protocol; do not use old reports as the only control.

conditions: mean coverage gain >= 0.05 over paired-seed CE controls
coverage improvement has the same sign for both seeds
micro accuracy within 0.01 of the released parent and paired CE controls
no source accuracy regression greater than 0.05
AURC no worse than parent and CE control
unknowable high-confidence share <= 0.05 and intact-control accuracy within 0.02 of parent
replication.final_checkpoint_choice: Among passing size/recipe groups, choose highest development coverage, then lowest NLL; write checkpoint hashes and thresholds before final scoring.

promotion_recommendation_requires: coverage gain >= 0.05 against parent and CE control, paired 95% CI lower bound > 0
fixed-threshold accepted-set empirical error <= 0.05 with minimum 100 accepted knowable questions
fresh unknown/control behavior does not collapse by predicting uniform distributions on intact records
final_audit.failing_final_test: report failure; do not select a different candidate using these outcomes

stop_rules: If the first screen has no passing arm, report the negative result and leave the fresh final set unscored.
Do not launch a full retrain merely because a screened loss was the least bad.
Do not spend on 27B or expand the loss grid without a new evidence-based decision and budget check.
Do not overwrite historical outputs, deployed production app, published checkpoints, or release tags.
